question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
  SELECT l.id_bioguide, l.gender, lt.state, CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) as first_term_start
  FROM legislators l
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
  WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
checkpoints AS (
  SELECT 0 as interval UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
legislator_checkpoints AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.id_bioguide,
    ft.gender,
    ft.state,
    ft.first_term_start,
    cp.interval,
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('year', ft.first_term_start) + INTERVAL (cp.interval + 1) YEAR - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATE) as checkpoint_date
  FROM first_terms ft
  CROSS JOIN checkpoints cp
),
retention_check AS (
  SELECT 
    lc.id_bioguide,
    lc.gender,
    lc.state,
    lc.interval,
    lc.checkpoint_date,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2
      WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = lc.id_bioguide
        AND CAST(lt2.term_start AS DATE) <= lc.checkpoint_date
        AND CAST(lt2.term_end AS DATE) >= lc.checkpoint_date
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
  FROM legislator_checkpoints lc
),
retention_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    state, gender, interval,
    COUNT(*) as total,
    SUM(retained) as retained_count,
    1.0 * SUM(retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
  FROM retention_check
  GROUP BY state, gender, interval
),
states_valid AS (
  SELECT state
  FROM retention_rates
  GROUP BY state
  HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' AND retention_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 6
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' AND retention_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 6
)
SELECT state FROM states_valid ORDER BY state
